jobs.title: Product Manager, Business Intelligence
jobs.description:
CULTIVATE A BETTER WORLD

Food served fast does not have to be a typical fast-food experience. Chipotle has always done things differently, both in and out of our restaurants. We are changing the face of fast food, starting conversations, and directly supporting efforts to shift the future of farming and food. We hope you will join us as we continue to learn, evolve, and shape what comes next on our mission to make better food accessible to everyone.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are seeking an exceptional and highly strategic Data Product Manager to define and lead the data product vision for Customer, CRM/Rewards/Loyalty, Digital Marketing, and Marketing. This is a high-impact role for a product leader who can connect customer and business strategy to enterprise data capabilities, shape the long-term roadmap, and drive measurable outcomes across guest growth, retention, personalization, and marketing performance. The ideal candidate will bring strong product judgment, executive presence, and the ability to influence cross-functional partners across business, technology, and analytics to build durable, high-value data products that scale with the company.

WHAT YOU’LL DO
- Set the Strategic Product Direction: Define the long-term vision, strategy, and roadmap for customer and marketing data products, ensuring investments align to enterprise priorities, guest growth, loyalty engagement, digital performance, and brand impact.
- Own High-Value Business Outcomes: Lead product decisions with a clear focus on business value, translating customer and marketing opportunities into scalable data products that improve personalization, targeting, measurement, retention, and decision quality.
- Shape Enterprise Customer Data Capabilities: Drive the evolution of data products that unify guest, loyalty, campaign, transactional, and digital behavior data into a trusted foundation for segmentation, lifecycle marketing, attribution, and customer intelligence.
- Influence Senior Stakeholders and Cross-Functional Strategy: Partner closely with leaders across Marketing, CRM, Loyalty, Digital, Insights, Data Science, and Engineering to align priorities, shape investment decisions, and ensure data products are tightly connected to strategic business needs.
- Lead Through Ambiguity and Complexity: Navigate complex, evolving problem spaces by setting clear direction, making thoughtful tradeoffs, and balancing short-term delivery with long-term platform and product value.
- Drive Product Excellence Across the Lifecycle: Lead the full product lifecycle—from discovery, strategy, and prioritization through launch, adoption, measurement, and iteration—using strong product management practices and agile delivery discipline.
- Raise the Bar for Trust, Quality, and Usability: Champion strong definitions, governance, and quality standards across customer and marketing data domains so teams can confidently act on insights and embed data products into day-to-day decision-making.
- Build for Scale and Enduring Value: Ensure the portfolio evolves beyond one-off requests and reporting needs into strategic, reusable, scalable data products that unlock long-term enterprise value.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO THE TABLE
- Deep Product Management Experience: Significant experience in product management, including leading complex data, platform, or analytics products with clear ownership of strategy, prioritization, and business outcomes.
- Strategic Product Leadership: Demonstrated ability to define bold product visions, influence senior stakeholders, shape multi-quarter roadmaps, and make high-quality tradeoff decisions in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
- Customer and Marketing Domain Strength: Strong command of customer, CRM, rewards/loyalty, digital marketing, and marketing measurement concepts, with the ability to translate business opportunities into differentiated data products and capabilities.
- Business and Outcome Orientation: Proven track record of delivering products that drive measurable impact, such as improved customer engagement, retention, personalization effectiveness, marketing efficiency, or decision quality.
- Enterprise Influence and Cross-Functional Leadership: Exceptional ability to influence without authority and partner effectively across executive stakeholders, business teams, engineering, analytics, data science, and architecture functions.
- Strong Technical and Data Fluency: Strong understanding of data architecture, data modeling, experimentation, data quality, analytics workflows, and modern data platforms, with the ability to work credibly with technical teams and make informed product decisions.
- Excellent Product Judgment: Ability to separate signal from noise, identify where the highest-value opportunities exist, and focus teams on the work that matters most.
- Communication and Executive Presence: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to bring clarity to complexity, tell a compelling product story, and build alignment at multiple levels of the organization.
- Builder’s Mindset: A strong bias toward action, a high bar for quality, and a passion for building durable products and capabilities that create meaningful value for customers and the business.

PAY TRANSPARENCY

A reasonable estimate of the current base pay range for this position is $133,000.00–$187,000.00. You are also eligible for annual cash bonuses and equity awards based upon performance and other factors. Actual compensation offered may vary depending on skill level, experience, and/or education. Chipotle offers a competitive total rewards package, which includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401k, sick leave, vacation time, and much more. Visit https://jobs.chipotle.com/benefits for more details.
WHO WE ARE

Chipotle Mexican Grill, Inc. (NYSE: CMG) is cultivating a better world by serving responsibly sourced, classically cooked, real food with wholesome ingredients without artificial colors, flavors or preservatives. Chipotle has restaurants in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, France and Germany and is the only restaurant company of its size that owns and operates all its restaurants in North America and Europe. With employees passionate about providing a great guest experience, Chipotle is a longtime leader and innovator in the food industry. Chipotle is committed to making its food more accessible to everyone while continuing to be a brand with a demonstrated purpose as it leads the way in digital, technology and sustainable business practices. For more information or to place an order online, visit WWW.CHIPOTLE.COM

Chipotle Mexican Grill is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity at all levels. As a people-first company rooted in values, our purpose extends beyond serving nutritious food using real ingredients. It means hiring world-class individuals and fostering a culture that champions diversity, ensures equity, and celebrates inclusion. All qualified applicants, regardless of personal characteristics, are encouraged to apply.

Qualified applicants with disabilities may be entitled to reasonable accommodation under the terms of the Americans with Disabilities Act and/or certain state or local laws. Please contact ADAaccommodations@chipotle.com if you need an accommodation due to a disability to complete an application, job interview, and/or to otherwise participate in the hiring process. This email does not respond to non-accommodations related requests.

THE OPPORTUNITY

As the Senior Product Owner, Workforce Management & Pay Technology, you will be responsible for driving the vision for transformative employee experiences across our digital landscape, including Workforce Management & Pay Technology. In collaboration with cross-functional teams in Technology, Human Resources, Legal, Operations, and Finance, you will convert complex business needs into scalable digital solutions.

WHAT YOU’LL DO
- Strong candidates are motivated by what they can achieve, growth they could experience, and how they will impact the company.
- Guide the roadmap for HRIT/Workforce Management & Pay Technology, ensuring alignment with organizational goals.
- Provide technical subject matter expertise through clear and concise communication of product goals and detailed requirements to the Agile Teams, ensuring requirements are understood and stakeholder value is achieved.
- Participate in discovery sessions for new features and projects that continually evolve our HR technology landscape while contributing domain knowledge and technical expertise.
- Own the Technical Product Backlog, leading grooming sessions, and prioritizing features as the Technical Subject Matter Expert (SME) while defining feature priorities.
- Track deliverable timelines and communicate delivery dates to stakeholders.
- Take responsibility in assuring a level of quality has been achieved through validation and tests prior and post-production launch verification.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO THE TABLE
Experience and Expertise
- High school diploma or general education degree (GED) required.
- Bachelor's Degree (BA/BS) from 4-year college or university preferred.
- 5 or more years of experience as a Product Owner or in a similar role

- Experience with Workforce Management systems such as UKG required

- Experience with Payroll systems such as Workday Payroll preferred

- Proven ability to own a roadmap, backlog, and delivery

Product and Technical Skills
- Strong product mindset focused on outcomes and user value

- Experience working in Agile environments such as Scrum or Kanban

- Skilled in writing user stories and managing backlogs

- Experience with tools such as JIRA, ServiceNow, or similar

- Understanding of integrations, data flows, and enterprise systems

Leadership and Communication
- Ability to influence and align partners across business and technology

- Clear communicator who can simplify complex topics

Confident in making decisions and driving accountability
